Example Genotype Matrix

Source: R/example_data.R
gs_example_geno.Rd

A simulated additive-dosage matrix for 120 genotypes and 240 biallelic markers on three chromosomes. Four 20-marker founder-haplotype blocks are simulated per chromosome. Population-specific founder frequencies create moderate genomic structure across three populations while retaining shared founders. One call per marker is missing when the default settings are used, leaving every marker safely above the default 0.95 call-rate threshold in `grm_builder.R`.

Usage

gs_example_geno

Format

A numeric matrix with 120 rows and 240 columns. Rows are genotypes `G001` through `G120`; columns are marker IDs such as `S1_0001`. Values are 0, 1, 2, or `NA`, representing alternate-allele dosage.

Source

Generated by `data-raw/generate_example_data.R` with default seed 20261106.

Examples

data(gs_example_geno)
dim(gs_example_geno)
#> [1] 120 240
table(gs_example_geno, useNA = "ifany")
#> gs_example_geno
#>     0     1     2  <NA> 
#>  8687 10565  9308   240
